republish.done_one: Done. 1 page was checked, using {{writes}} writes.
republish.done_other: Done. {{count}} pages were checked, using {{writes}} writes.
republish.stopped_one: Stopped after 1 page. Resume to continue where you left off.
republish.stopped_other: Stopped after {{count}} pages. Resume to continue where you left off.
republish.skipped_one: 1 page could not be republished and was skipped.
republish.skipped_other: {{count}} pages could not be republished and were skipped.
